oi_source: NSE official participant-wise EOD OI CSV archive
oi_scope_warning: NSE participant-wise OI is aggregate Index F&O participant totals, not separate NIFTY/SENSEX/BANKNIFTY participant OI. The same aggregate OI features are tested independently against each index price series.

data_adequacy.note: 250 sessions is approximately one trading year and a broader exploratory coverage target, not a statistical guarantee. A live score still requires stable out-of-sample incremental value.

validation.chronological_split: first 70% train; last 30% holdout, ordered by date
validation.directional_hit_rate: Futures net/leg OI changes and CLIENT option directional net quantity are tested as signed crowd-direction signals. CE long and PE short changes are bullish; CE short and PE long changes are bearish. Other option features remain correlation-only.
validation.false_signal_rate: Non-zero signed futures and explicitly directional CLIENT option quantity feature signs versus forward return sign; zero-return observations excluded; no optimized threshold.
validation.regime_method: signal-date-only SMA20 and its five-session slope
validation.reason: Exploratory OI diagnostics only. No OI weight or trading score is assigned; aggregate scope, sample size and incremental value remain limiting factors.
validation.client_option_quantity_definition: Directional crowd quantity = change in CLIENT CE long − CE short + PE short − PE long. CE long and PE short additions are bullish; CE short and PE long additions are bearish. The user's raw arithmetic net (CE long − CE short + PE long − PE short) is retained as a separate correlation-only diagnostic.

data_quality.regime_definition: As of signal date t: bull if close > SMA20 and SMA20(t) > SMA20(t-5); bear if close < SMA20 and SMA20(t) < SMA20(t-5); otherwise sideways. Only data available through t is used.
data_quality.target_definition: OI known after EOD on date t; entry next trading session open; exit at the close of session 1, 3, or 5 counted from that next session. No same-day close entry.
data_quality.false_signal_definition: For explicitly marked futures and CLIENT option directional-net features, every non-zero signed quantity/feature is a raw directional call. Bullish signal followed by a negative return or bearish signal followed by a positive return is false. Zero-return observations are excluded; no optimized signal threshold is fitted.
data_quality.non_overlapping_holdout_method: For each horizon H, the chronological holdout is split into all H possible phase offsets using actual index-session positions. Within one phase, signal dates are at least H sessions apart, so forward windows do not overlap. Non-overlapping phases are reported for futures directional features only; options remain correlation-only. Phases are alternative partitions, not independent samples. Descriptive only: no phase selection or phase-level p-values.

directional_inference.chance_test: exact two-sided binomial test against 50% directional hit rate
directional_inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction within this index across explicitly directional futures and CLIENT option quantity participant/field/horizon tests
directional_inference.dependence_warning: Nominal binomial p-values assume independent hit outcomes. Forward-return horizons overlap and participant OI is shared across index tests. Non-overlapping phase rows are descriptive alternatives and are not independent across phases; these values are exploratory, not confirmatory.
directional_inference.interpretation: No live-score eligibility; use only as a conservative diagnostic.

client_futures_recent_7_session_check.method: CLIENT Futures EOD OI Δ(Long−Short), scaled by prior gross exposure to ±10; compare direct and contrarian signs with next NSE session close-to-close index direction
client_futures_recent_7_session_check.scope: NSE participant-wise CLIENT Index Futures aggregate; market-wide, not index-specific

global_directional_inference.chance_test: exact two-sided binomial test against 50% directional hit rate
global_directional_inference.multiple_testing: One Holm family across all available index × participant/field × horizon directional tests
global_directional_inference.dependence_warning: The same market-wide NSE participant OI inputs are reused across NIFTY, SENSEX and BANKNIFTY; 1/3/5-session forward windows overlap and outcomes may be serially dependent. Global Holm correction is more conservative, but does not make observations independent or establish a tradable edge.

magnitude_threshold_inference.method: 95% Wilson interval and exact two-sided binomial test against 50% PDMP hit rate
magnitude_threshold_inference.multiple_testing: One Holm family-wise correction across every available index × horizon × training-quantile threshold comparison in this report
magnitude_threshold_inference.dependence_warning: Exploratory only. The same market-wide CLIENT OI input is reused for all index price series; 1/3/5-session forward windows overlap; threshold quantiles are fixed from training data only. Holm correction controls the listed family under its assumptions but does not make these correlated observations independent or establish a tradable edge.
